api_key_scopes_revocation_reason_ck.name: api_key_scopes_revocation_reason_ck
api_key_scopes_revocation_reason_ck.value:
("api_key_scopes"."revoked_at" IS NULL AND "api_key_scopes"."revoked_reason" IS NULL) OR
        ("api_key_scopes"."revoked_at" IS NOT NULL AND NULLIF(BTRIM("api_key_scopes"."revoked_reason"), '') IS NOT NULL)

cleanup_jobs_lease_ck.name: cleanup_jobs_lease_ck
cleanup_jobs_lease_ck.value:
("cleanup_jobs"."state" = 'running') =
        ("cleanup_jobs"."lease_token" IS NOT NULL AND "cleanup_jobs"."lease_expires_at" IS NOT NULL)

cleanup_jobs_operation_target_ck.name: cleanup_jobs_operation_target_ck
cleanup_jobs_operation_target_ck.value:
("cleanup_jobs"."operation" IN ('membership_disable', 'membership_remove') AND
          "cleanup_jobs"."target_type" = 'organization_membership') OR
        ("cleanup_jobs"."operation" = 'team_delete' AND "cleanup_jobs"."target_type" = 'team') OR
        ("cleanup_jobs"."operation" = 'role_reduce' AND "cleanup_jobs"."target_type" = 'role') OR
        ("cleanup_jobs"."operation" = 'access_revoke' AND "cleanup_jobs"."target_type" = 'workspace_access') OR
        ("cleanup_jobs"."operation" = 'workspace_delete' AND "cleanup_jobs"."target_type" = 'workspace')

event_trail_events_actor_ck.name: event_trail_events_actor_ck
event_trail_events_actor_ck.value:
("event_trail_events"."actor_type" = 'system' AND "event_trail_events"."actor_id" IS NULL) OR
        ("event_trail_events"."actor_type" <> 'system' AND "event_trail_events"."actor_id" IS NOT NULL)

role_scopes_organization_system_uidx.name: role_scopes_organization_system_uidx
role_scopes_organization_system_uidx.where: "role_scopes"."system_role" IS NOT NULL AND "role_scopes"."workspace_id" IS NULL

role_scopes_workspace_system_uidx.name: role_scopes_workspace_system_uidx
role_scopes_workspace_system_uidx.where: "role_scopes"."system_role" IS NOT NULL AND "role_scopes"."workspace_id" IS NOT NULL

role_scopes_system_role_ck.name: role_scopes_system_role_ck
role_scopes_system_role_ck.value:
("role_scopes"."system_role" IS NULL OR "role_scopes"."immutable") AND
        ("role_scopes"."system_role" IS DISTINCT FROM 'superadmin' OR "role_scopes"."workspace_id" IS NULL) AND
        ("role_scopes"."system_role" IS DISTINCT FROM 'workspace_admin' OR "role_scopes"."workspace_id" IS NOT NULL)

tenant_cutovers_activation_ck.name: tenant_cutovers_activation_ck
tenant_cutovers_activation_ck.value:
("tenant_cutovers"."verified_at" IS NOT NULL) = ("tenant_cutovers"."checkpoint" IN ('verified', 'sql', 'activated')) AND
        ("tenant_cutovers"."activated_at" IS NOT NULL) = ("tenant_cutovers"."checkpoint" = 'activated')

workspaces_state_failure_reason_ck.name: workspaces_state_failure_reason_ck
workspaces_state_failure_reason_ck.value:
("workspaces"."state" = 'failed' AND NULLIF(BTRIM("workspaces"."failure_reason"), '') IS NOT NULL) OR
        ("workspaces"."state" <> 'failed' AND "workspaces"."failure_reason" IS NULL)
